description: Structural read of a brain.klypix: the most-connected "hub" cards (load-bearing decisions), orphaned decisions (no connections — maybe forgotten), stale open questions (aging & unresolved), and area sizes. Use to answer "what matters here / what am I forgetting / what should I review?" — read it at the start of a planning session, or before tidying.

canvas.description: Canvas filename/path. Defaults to the project brain ("brain").

staleDays.description: Open questions older than this many days count as stale (default 21).

view.description: "areas" = a cheap category map (what sections exist + live counts) to orient BEFORE retrieving. "status" = where each active area stands (newest milestone + open count). "full" (default) = hubs, orphans, stale questions and areas.

name: brain_insights
title: What matters in a brain — hubs, orphans, stale questions
